This plugin is listed in `charly/charly.yml`'s `compiled_plugins:`, so its providers are compiled into the `charly` binary and register in-process.

## Providers

The reserved words this plugin serves:

- **`pi`** — agent-runtime class

## What it does

Generic agent-runtime:pi provider. Launches the ephemeral native Pi
SDK runner, carries Pi's upstream runRpcMode JSONL over the generic
CUE-generated Provider.Channel, persists through SessionManager, and
exits at Pi's deterministic agent_end event. No daemon or listener.
An opt-in adapter delegates to the official experimental Pi
orchestrator rpc-stream CLI without duplicating its socket protocol.

## Parameter schema

The CUE schema below is the authoritative grammar for this plugin's input. It is the same single source that generates the plugin's Go parameter types and answers the runtime `Describe` RPC, so this page cannot disagree with either.

### `schema/pi.cue`

```cue
// Pi owns the RPC semantics and implementation. This version-pinned boundary
// schema owns every JSONL field Charly accepts or emits while delegating those
// messages unchanged to upstream runRpcMode.
#PiPlugin: {
	runtime:  "pi"
	contract: "pi-rpc-0.80.10"
}

#PiRPCCommand: {
	id?: string & !=""
	// S3: the words are rows of the `_commandType` table at the foot of this
	// file; the enum is `or()` of its derived word list, so the catalog has ONE
	// home.
	type: or(_commandTypeWord)
	message?:               string
	images?: [..._]
	streamingBehavior?:     or(_streamingBehaviorWord)
	parentSession?:         string
	provider?:              string & !=""
	modelId?:               string & !=""
	level?:                 string & !=""
	mode?:                  or(_modeWord)
	customInstructions?:    string
	enabled?:               bool
	command?:               string
	excludeFromContext?:    bool
	outputPath?:            string
	sessionPath?:           string & !=""
	entryId?:               string & !=""
	since?:                 string
	name?:                  string & !=""
	value?:                 string
	confirmed?:             bool
	cancelled?:             bool
}

#PiGetStateCommand: {
	id:   string & !=""
	type: "get_state"
}

#PiPromptCommand: {
	id:      string & !=""
	type:    "prompt"
	message: string & !=""
}

#PiAbortCommand: {
	type: "abort"
}

// Events are passed through losslessly. The discriminator and the response
// fields Charly interprets are closed and typed; event-specific upstream data
// remains opaque to the adapter.
#PiRPCEvent: {
	type:     string & !=""
	id?:      string
	command?: string
	success?: bool
	error?:   string
	data?:    _
	...
}

#PiRPCState: {
	model?:                  _
	thinkingLevel:           string & !=""
	isStreaming:             bool
	isCompacting:            bool
	steeringMode:            or(_modeWord)
	followUpMode:            or(_modeWord)
	sessionFile?:            string @go(SessionFile)
	sessionId:               string & !=""
	sessionName?:            string
	autoCompactionEnabled:   bool
	messageCount:            int & >=0
	pendingMessageCount:     int & >=0
}

#PiRPCStateResponse: {
	id?:     string
	type:    "response"
	command: "get_state"
	success: bool
	data?:   #PiRPCState @go(Data,type=*PiRPCState)
	error?:  string
}

// --- vocabulary tables (S3) --------------------------------------------------
// Every closed set of words is a table keyed by word, and its word list is
// derived from the table and used as `or()` of that list (§10.1 S3, D-PAT-3).
// The table and the enum it feeds therefore cannot disagree, and a new word is
// ONE row here. `@vocab` names the owner (§3.1): this set is compiled into THIS
// plugin, so the owner is the plugin's own word `pi`.
_commandType: {
	prompt: {}
	steer: {}
	follow_up: {}
	abort: {}
	new_session: {}
	get_state: {}
	set_model: {}
	cycle_model: {}
	get_available_models: {}
	set_thinking_level: {}
	cycle_thinking_level: {}
	set_steering_mode: {}
	set_follow_up_mode: {}
	compact: {}
	set_auto_compaction: {}
	set_auto_retry: {}
	abort_retry: {}
	bash: {}
	abort_bash: {}
	get_session_stats: {}
	export_html: {}
	switch_session: {}
	fork: {}
	clone: {}
	get_fork_messages: {}
	get_entries: {}
	get_tree: {}
	get_last_assistant_text: {}
	set_session_name: {}
	get_messages: {}
	get_commands: {}
	extension_ui_response: {}
} @vocab(pi)
_commandTypeWord: [for w, _ in _commandType {w}]

_streamingBehavior: {steer: {}, "followUp": {}} @vocab(pi)
_streamingBehaviorWord: [for w, _ in _streamingBehavior {w}]

// ONE table for the ONE upstream enum Pi renders in three fields: the command's
// `mode`, and the state's `steeringMode` / `followUpMode`. Extracting on the
// second occurrence keeps the single home.
_mode: {all: {}, "one-at-a-time": {}} @vocab(pi)
_modeWord: [for w, _ in _mode {w}]
```
